newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Wills says first qtr results on budget.
newsitem.headline: Wills says first qtr results on budget.

text.p: Cigarette maker W.D. & HO. Wills Holdings Ltd chairman Nick Greiner said on Thursday the group's first quarter results were in line with budget and he expected results for calendar 1997 to be also on budget targets.

"Following last year's very pleasing result, our progress during the first quarter has been in line with budget and barring any unforeseen circumstances we would expect this to continue," Greiner told the annual meeting.

Greiner, repeating chief executive Stuart Watterton's comments on Wednesday, said reports of a looming tobacco price war were incorrect but Wills would continue to be price-competitive and watch the market closely.
Wills, which is 67 percent owned by B.A.T. Industries, reported a A$13.27 million profit in calendar 1996, up from a loss of A$5.16 million in 1995, which was due to a price war two years ago.
Watterton has rejected a claim by local rival Philip Morris Australia that Wills had begun another price war which would reduce industry earnings by A$100 million.
